learning_outcomes.text: Be able to solve problems of calculating velocities, accelerations and forces on mechanisms and machines.
Know how to use computer resources for the calculation of kinematics and dynamics of mechanisms and machines.
Be able to prepare technical reports in the field of analysis and design of mechanisms.
Be able to analyze and design mechanisms and machines, from a kinematic and dynamic point of view.
Be able to identify the components of a machine or mechanism in a diagram or plan and in a real system.
Be able to kinematically analyze the most common mechanisms used in machines.
Be able to design, at a preliminary level, machine transmissions made up of belts, chains, gears, parts, shafts, etc.
Be able to calculate the dynamic behavior of a machine's transmission system.

syllabus_topics: Tema 1 - Structure of machines and mechanisms
1. Basic concepts of machines and mechanisms.
1. Dynamics of operation. Driving and resisting curves.
Tema 4 - Kinematics and Dynamics of Mechanisms
2. Cable, pulley and block and tackle transmission.
1. Basic concepts and typologies of gears.
L1. Analysis of machine components and mobility of mechanisms.
L2. Computer-aided kinematic and dynamic modeling of mechanisms (I).
L3. Computer-aided kinematic and dynamic modeling of mechanisms (II).
L4. Computer-aided kinematic and dynamic modeling of mechanisms (III).
teaching_methods: Laboratory work combined with cooperative learning
Learning through Virtual Classroom activities (online communication)
assessment_rules: To pass the course, a global score of at least 5 out of 10 is required. In each call, the global score will be obtained by averaging the different parts. It is essential to obtain a score equal to or greater than 5 out of 10 in the final exam to be able to average. If this requirement is not met and the weighted global score is greater than 4.5 points, the final global score will be 4.5 out of 10. Lab practices are not recoverable. Continuous assessment tests are recoverable, possibly through the final exam or a specific resit.
